thread:
Alex K: hey folks :wave: i'm on my first PR for INC-42 and want to make sure i follow our conventions. quick list: branch naming, when to mark draft vs ready, which CI checks are required, who to tag for runtime changes, and any tips on PR size/style? TL;DR appreciated.
Devex Bot: congrats and welcome! :tada: short answers: branch names like `feat/INC-42-short-desc` or `fix/INC-42-short-desc`. Use `draft` state for WIP. PR title should start with the ticket (INC-42) and a one-line summary. Full contributing guide: https://git.redwood.ai/CONTRIBUTING.md
Maria P: +1 to Devex. also run `pre-commit run --all-files` locally before pushing — we have formatting and lint hooks. keep PRs focused (try <400 LOC or split into follow-ups).
Sam T: CI notes: each PR triggers `redwoodci/build` and `redwoodci/linters`. integration tests run on merges to main. if you see flaky tests, add `flaky:` notes in the PR body. labels we use: `area/runtime`, `area/infra`, `needs-review`, `requires-cherry-pick`.
CI Bot: redwoodci/linters — queued
Chris L: if this touches serving/runtime code, include a very short perf blurb (latency before/after) and example repro steps. ping me (@Chris L) early for design feedback — can save a round of reviews.
Alex K: thanks! small question: do we squash merges or preserve commits?
Devex Bot: default is squash-and-merge for most PRs to keep history clean. exceptions: large feature branches where intermediate commits are meaningful — discuss on the PR and include a note in the description. also, make sure to enable "Allow maintainers to edit" so CI fixes can be applied.
Maria P: review process: at least one approval from codeowners for the area. if touching multiple areas, try to get one reviewer per affected area. write a short checklist in the PR description: what you changed, why, how to test, and any rollout/rollback notes.
Sam T: branching tip: use `chore/cleanup-<ticket>` for non-feature work. for hotfixes to production follow the release runbook and include `hotfix/` prefix.
Alex K: got it. i'll push a draft PR and drop the link here — would love an initial sanity check before formal reviews :pray:
Maria P: sounds good, drop it and i'll take a look after lunch :coffee:
CI Bot: redwoodci/linters — running
Alex K: thanks everyone :heart:
